title: Premium Billing Accounts: Vision Plan Termination Credits and the Vision Credit Booking Tool
content:
**Scope.** On Premium Billing Accounts, this credit rule governs the termination credit for a vision plan unit funded by an individual-market account (Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly, Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly, Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill or Cascade Individual Annual Prepay) whose subscriber enrollment in Vision Plans ended by voluntary termination — and only for such a unit. Cascade gives back vision premium that was billed for a vision plan unit whose coverage has ended.

**When it is due.** The credit is owed by Cascade once the records show such a unit: the subscriber's Vision Plans enrollment funded by the account carries a voluntary termination. It is booked on the account by the agent.

**Business effect.** The credit is recorded on the account's billing ledger as a premium credit on the vision product line, marked as a termination credit — a vision-line termination credit — dated the booking day, posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last, carrying the number of coverage months it gives back and the amount; it lowers the account's current balance by that amount. The account holder sees the credit on the ledger and a lower balance due.

## Booking tool — `book_vision_term_credit_956578a0`

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_vision_term_credit_956578a0` and then calls it. One call records one credit.

**Parameters**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `billing_account_id` | the reference number of the premium billing account the credit is booked to, as returned by the billing-account lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `coverage_month` | the coverage month of the invoice the credit is posted against | YYYY-MM (four-digit year, hyphen, two-digit month), no day part |
| `months_covered` | the number of coverage months the credit gives back | whole number of months, no fraction |
| `credit_amount` | the amount credited back, in USD | positive number with 2 decimal places; a value given with more places is rounded half up to the cent when booked |

**Return.** A receipt with: `billing_txn_id` (the ledger reference of the new credit), `billing_account_id` (the account credited), `product_line` (always `vision`), `credit_reason` (always `termination_unearned`), `coverage_month` (YYYY-MM), `months_covered` (integer), `amount` (USD, 2 decimals, the amount credited), `txn_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the booking date) and `balance_due` (USD, 2 decimals, the account's balance with the credit booked; negative means a credit balance). A receipt carrying `billing_txn_id` means the credit is on the ledger.

**Hypothetical input and receipt.** Called with an account reference, `coverage_month` 2031-04, `months_covered` 2 and `credit_amount` 18.40, the tool returns a receipt whose `amount` is 18.40, whose `product_line` is `vision` and whose `balance_due` is the former balance less 18.40.
